message.content:
**Average Temperature – Los Angeles (December)**  

| Metric | Typical Range |
|--------|---------------|
| **Daily Highs** | ~18–22 °C (64–72 °F) |
| **Daily Lows** | ~10–13 °C (50–55 °F) |

*Overall monthly averages:*  
- Mean maximum ≈ 20 °C (68 °F).  
- Mean minimum ≈ 12 °C (54 °F).

These figures come from long‑term climatological records (e.g., NOAA’s National Centers for Environmental Information), which show December as one of the cooler months in Southern California—but still mild compared with many other U.S. regions. Weather can vary; occasional cold fronts may drop temps into the low teens Celsius during nighttime hours.
